summary: Frontend testing completed for football/futsal team management app with coaching features. All 11 requested features tested and PASSED. Coaching panel now shows 3 categories (Team Level, Defensive Line, Attack) with full tactic cards showing quote, problem, principle, actions. Tactical arrows render on pitch when applying coaching tactics.

known_issues_from_prev_iteration.issue: Formation switching causes most players to disappear from pitch. Only 3 players visible instead of 11.
known_issues_from_prev_iteration.status: STILL PRESENT - Not fixed in this iteration

test_2_match_mode_button_on_tactics.description: Tactics screen green button says 'MATCH MODE' instead of 'START MATCH'

test_3_match_setup_header.description: Match setup screen heading says 'MATCH MODE'

test_4_minutes_per_half_selector.description: Shows 'MINUTES PER HALF' selector with options: 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45

test_5_total_match_time_hint.description: Shows 'Total match time: 90 min (45 x 2 halves)' hint below duration selector

test_6_expected_playing_time_section.description: EXPECTED PLAYING TIME section shows all players with progress bars. GK gets 90 min, outfield players get ~75 min each for rotation

test_7_substitution_plan_preview.description: SUBSTITUTION PLAN section shows upcoming subs with minute markers

test_8_start_match_button_position.description: START MATCH button is at bottom of match setup screen

test_9_live_match_half_labels.description: Timer shows '1ST HALF' label with progress bar and halftime marker at 50%

test_10_coaching_panel_3_categories.description: Coaching panel opens with exactly 3 categories: Team Level (2 tactics), Defensive Line (2 tactics), Attack (2 tactics)

test_11_coaching_tactic_card_content.description: Each coaching tactic card shows: quote (italic), quotedBy (manager name), problem (red dot), principle (green dot), action items (bullet points), APPLY ON PITCH button

test_12_tactical_arrows_on_pitch.description: Applying coaching tactic renders arrows on pitch view illustrating movement (blue arrows, red dashed arrows visible)
